hypothesis: Insufficient early-horizon practice may contribute to a weak early-survival lower tail; this is unproven.

comparison.same_reward: score + alive_frames/100 - 5 on true death; learner reward_scale 0.1
comparison.training_seed_vectors: matched across arms; exact values reserved and audited by parent before environment construction
comparison.replica_seed_vectors: three disjoint paired vectors reserved and audited by parent
comparison.optimizer_decision_budget: same rollout decisions and optimizer updates for every pair
comparison.resource_accounting: Report learner decisions, optimizer steps, environment raw frames, cutoff resets, and startup/replay frames separately. Equal PPO decisions do not imply equal raw-frame or reset cost; enforce a parent-approved raw-frame and wall-resource ceiling before launch. Do not silently top up either arm.
comparison.control_reuse: Share an existing control only if source, config, parent, seeds, budget, exclusions, and evaluation fields match exactly before launch; otherwise create isolated matched control runs.
comparison.isolation: Curriculum code, config, run outputs, and checkpoints stay under this design's successor-owned directory. No reuse of existing-control or LR-study preparation paths.

curriculum.horizon_unit: raw gameplay frames from normal episode start; action_repeat remains 4
curriculum.mix: At stage H>1000, assign 70% of episode slots to current target H and 30% across all earlier horizons [1000, H-1000] as evenly as possible. At H=1000, assign 100% to 1000.
curriculum.assignment: Deterministic paired stream keyed by replica, matched training-seed vector, learner-update index, slot, and per-slot episode index. Both arms log assignment keys; control gets no curriculum cutoff.

mastery_rule.label: PROPOSED, not user-approved
mastery_rule.eligible_episodes: Current-target episodes only; minimum 200 completed target episodes after entering stage.
mastery_rule.success: Survive through H raw gameplay frames without true death. Practice cutoff at H is success; death on the transition reaching H is failure and takes precedence.
mastery_rule.stability: Two consecutive non-overlapping windows of 100 eligible target episodes each must each meet or exceed 90% success, and minimum stage exposure must be met.
mastery_rule.advance: Advance one 1000-frame stage after all mastery conditions pass. At 18000, stop stage advancement.
mastery_rule.reset: Any failed 100-episode window resets the consecutive-window count to zero; remain at current stage and keep collecting. No automatic stage decrease.
mastery_rule.fallback: If mastery is not met within 60 updates, finish the registered pilot at the current stage, mark later stages untested, and do not extend budget.

curriculum.earlier_horizon_episodes: Keep their success/failure counts by horizon as practice diagnostics. They do not count toward current-stage mastery. A prior-horizon success never advances stage.
curriculum.stage_assignment: Freeze assignment for each episode at normal reset. Preserve 256-decision rollouts; stage horizon changes episode experience, not rollout size.

practice_cutoff_contract.true_death: Keep existing termination and death reward. Do not bootstrap terminal value or GAE across the death boundary.
practice_cutoff_contract.survived_horizon: Emit truncated=true, terminated=false, no death penalty; compute value on the actual final continuing observation before resetting that slot; bootstrap that value, stop GAE carry across reset, then start a fresh normal episode.
practice_cutoff_contract.same_transition_death_and_horizon: True death wins; count failure, terminated=true, truncated=false, no bootstrap.
practice_cutoff_contract.current_api_finding: Frozen PPO reads final observations before reset_done and GAE supports alive truncation. Native reset_done rejects active slots, and current step/reset API offers no practice-cutoff operation. Isolated native/wrapper extension is required; do not fake only Python flags.
practice_cutoff_contract.evaluation: Disable practice cutoffs. Every evaluation episode starts normally and runs to true death or full 18000 raw-frame cap.

evaluation.full_run_cohort: New disjoint fresh-seed cohort(s), reserved and ancestry-audited by parent before either arm trains; use identical cohort and exclusions for both arms. No B/E cohort opens.
evaluation.required_exclusion_union: Preserve and parent-audit existing B, E, D128, D100-ranking, and D200-confirmation exclusions before environment construction; add new evaluation cohort exclusions identically to both arms.
evaluation.quartiles: Sort full-run survival rows independently per metric; Q1 and Q4 are means of bottom and top quarters. Report sample count and paired per-seed differences.
evaluation.training_counts: Report milestone successes over eligible episodes by target horizon and stream. Training episodes are not fresh held-out evaluation. Analyze seed vector as unit; episode outcomes within seed are clustered, not independent bootstrap rows.

architecture_and_ppo.model: Frozen OmniscientEntityTeacher entity transformer, same exact accepted checkpoint and model source for both arms

before_training: new seed reservation and exclusion audit
gates.source_pin_impact: Any isolated PPO/native extension changes runtime and native source hashes and requires a new successor pin, registration, and independent review. Frozen predecessors remain unchanged.
gates.authority: Parent owns registration, review, resources, seeds, and acceptance. This artifact grants no launch or qualification authority.
